releaseNotes:
## Conferences
- Import registration sheet (CSV/Excel) into conference participants, with day vs overnight estimated from notes and dates
- Meal planner: per-day times can be edited reliably; shows 2-meal / 3-meal summary (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner — coffee breaks excluded)
- Monthly hover on conference row includes main-meal summary
- Stay-only days (before/after meeting days) use guest colors from people in the room (e.g. single male blue, not family green)

## Fixes
- Conference meal day labels no longer cause hydration mismatches
